ns2:section.sectionText: Financial Aid is generally not available for the winter session. If you have specific questions regarding your aid eligibility contact the Office of Student Financial Aid at finaid@illinois.edu or 217-333-0100. This section has one or more proctored exams, which may carry additional fees. For ProctorU technical specifications and additional information visit: http://www.ao.uiuc.edu/support/source/student_services/proctoru_tech.html
